column2: {title} provides indicator-wise performance data for measles immunisation under the Reproductive and Child Health (RCH) programme. It supports monitoring of child health services and programme review, using provisional figures from the HMIS portal of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides indicator-wise performance data on Family Planning, focusing on Oral Pill Users, compiled for RCH reporting. It gives provisional figures and estimated eligible couples using specified calculation methods. The dataset draws from the HMIS portal under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides indicator-wise performance data on family planning under the RCH reporting framework, focusing on condom users. The dataset supports monitoring of contraceptive use patterns and estimated eligible-couple coverage, using HMIS portal inputs from MoHFW. It uses provisional estimates.

{title} provides indicator-wise performance measures for family planning, specifically Intra Uterine Contraceptive Device (IUCD) insertions. It supports monitoring of eligible couple estimates and provisional reporting. Source is the HMIS portal under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, with Central government context.

{title} provides RCH report indicator-wise performance data for immunisation, focused on Polio (OPV3). It helps track progress against program targets and supports monitoring and review of service delivery in the Family Welfare domain. Data are sourced from the HMIS portal under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and use provisional figures.

{title} tracks performance of Reproductive and Child Health (RCH) indicators across India, supporting monitoring of key family welfare and service delivery outcomes. It is intended for program review, trend analysis, and accountability reporting. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. It includes provisional figures.

{title} provides RCH report data focused on maternal health outcomes, specifically institutional deliveries. It compiles indicator-wise performance information used for programme monitoring and planning under the HMIS portal of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides indicator-wise immunisation performance data for RCH reporting, focusing on DT (2nd Dose) or DPT5 coverage. The dataset supports program monitoring and performance review of Family Welfare activities using HMIS portal data under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. It provides provisional figures.

{title} provides RCH report indicator data on performance for Diphtheria, Pertussis and Tetanus (DPT3) immunisation coverage. It supports monitoring of programme delivery and estimating coverage needs against projected births, using provisional HMIS-based figures. The data sit under the Central government programme framework.

{title} provides indicator-wise performance data for the RCH maternal health program on pregnant women receiving tetanus immunisation. It is compiled from the HMIS portal under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. Figures are provisional.

{title} provides performance indicators for maternal health under the RCH programme, focusing on Pregnant Women given 100 IFA (Prophylaxis Against Nutritional Anaemia). The dataset reports provisional figures. Data are sourced from the HMIS portal of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare at a central level.

{title} compiles RCH report indicator-wise performance measures for maternal health, specifically ANC coverage and deliveries. It supports monitoring service delivery and identifying gaps in reporting using HMIS portal data from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides performance data for operation major (general and spinal anaesthesia) across public facilities. It focuses on districts that have shifted to facility-wise data uploading on the HMIS portal, excluding medical colleges. The dataset covers facility reporting and nil-performance handling for operational indicators, with data compiled at range-wise level based on facility activity during the reporting period.

{title} provides indicator-wise comparative performance reports for maternal health covering ANC and deliveries. It is prepared from HMIS portal data under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. Figures are provisional.

{title} is a facility-performance report for public facilities handling C-section deliveries, aggregated and presented range-wise. It helps monitor service delivery performance, reporting completeness, and facility-level functioning across eligible districts on the HMIS portal. Prepared under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, focusing on district-level facility-wise uploads and excluding medical colleges. Data scope is facility-active and physically existing facilities.

{title} provides performance of public facilities conducting deliveries, aggregated and reported range-wise. The report is limited to districts that shifted to facility-wise data uploading on the HMIS portal and excludes medical colleges. It supports monitoring and review of delivery services by facility range, using HMIS operational facility reporting.

{title} provides performance data for public facilities performing Operation Minor (No or local anaesthesia), aggregated range-wise to support monitoring of service delivery. The report considers only districts that shifted to facility-wise uploading on the HMIS portal and excludes medical colleges. It covers facility-level active physical public facilities reporting to HMIS.

{title} provides key indicators from the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-4). The dataset is used for evidence-based planning and monitoring of family welfare and health outcomes at district level. It supports comparisons across districts and identification of priority areas within India. Update frequency is irregular.

{title} provides state-wise counts of health workers deployed at sub-centres located in tribal areas. It supports planning, monitoring and comparative analysis of rural health staffing in tribal belts. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare).

{title} provides staffing information on doctors posted or available at Community Health Centres located in tribal areas. It supports planning and monitoring of health service capacity. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. Coverage is by State/UT, including special coding for tribal/non-tribal categorizations.

{title} provides a classification of Indian States/UTs based on the average rural population covered by a health centre (PHC or CHC). It supports health planning, coverage assessment, and comparative analysis of rural service availability under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} presents the building position of Primary Health Centres across States/UTs, covering functioning, government buildings, and under-construction units. It supports planning, monitoring, and gap assessment for Family Welfare and Primary Health Centre infrastructure under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides information on rural Primary Health Care (PHC) infrastructure and the average rural population covered. Useful for monitoring rural service readiness and planning workforce and facility augmentation in underserved regions. Compiled by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. Note includes applicable exclusions where PHC/CHC does not function.

{title} provides State/UT-wise availability of doctors posted or engaged at Community Health Centres (CHCs). It supports analysis of manpower vacancy and shortfall, planning for staffing, and assessing coverage gaps across administrative units. Data pertains to sanctioned positions and vacancy/shortfall computation.

{title} provides facility-wise performance data on outpatient attendance for allopathic public facilities, aggregated and presented by range. Useful for monitoring service delivery capacity and utilisation across reporting periods at district-linked facility scales. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. Data are updated with HMIS facility definitions and exclude medical colleges, for facility-wise reporting districts.

{title} provides performance of AYUSH public facilities focused on outpatient attendance, aggregated and reported by range. It supports monitoring service utilization, facility reporting coverage, and comparative performance across administrative ranges. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, reflecting HMIS portal facility-wise uploads for selected districts.

{title} compiles records on Health and Family Welfare Training Centres and MPW(M) Training Centres across States/UTs. It supports monitoring of training infrastructure for health workers and planning of workforce development. Data source is the Training Division, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India.

{title} provides the building position of Community Health Centres (CHCs) across States/UTs, including total functioning and counts of government buildings and those under construction. It supports planning, capacity assessment, and monitoring of CHC infrastructure status. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare).

{title} gives the building position of Sub Centres across States/UTs for the Health and Family Welfare sector. It captures functioning and the split between government buildings and those under construction to support planning and infrastructure monitoring. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} presents State/UT-wise counts of sub-centres that lack ANMs and/or health workers. It supports planning and monitoring of frontline health manpower coverage. Data are compiled from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides HMIS item-wise reporting data from India’s Health Management Information System. It supports monitoring service delivery trends, validating health facility reporting, and analyzing performance at an item level over time. Prepared by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare).

{title} compiles vacancy and shortfall details for Male Health Workers posted at sub-centres across Indian States/UTs. It supports workforce planning, resource allocation, and policy monitoring within the health and family welfare system under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides State/UT-wise counts of radiographers posted or available at Community Health Centres located in tribal areas. It supports planning for human resources for health, staffing gap analysis, and monitoring of service readiness at CHCs. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} gives a state/UT level snapshot of vacancy positions under the Health and Family Welfare sector. It is intended for quick reference to assess workforce or position availability across administrative units and support planning and monitoring at central and state levels. Provided by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} compiles state-wise counts of health facilities that are functioning, covering Sub Centres, Primary Health Centres (PHCs) and Community Health Centres (CHCs). It supports monitoring of primary healthcare coverage and capacity planning. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). Coverage is by State/UT.

{title} provides rates compiled from the SRS Bulletin. The figures are based on India’s Sample Registration System (Office of the Registrar General, India) and support cross-State comparisons and health planning across States/UTs.

{title} provides State/UT-wise availability of doctors at Primary Health Centres (PHCs), including vacancy and shortfall indicators. It supports health workforce planning, monitoring of PHC staffing norms, and comparison across regions. Data are under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} presents the building position or status of sub-centres located in tribal areas across States/UTs. It supports planning, monitoring, and resource allocation for rural health infrastructure under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare. The data are organised at the State/UT level, with footnotes covering exceptions and repeated reference values.

{title} provides State/UT-wise data on the establishment and functioning of Community Health Centres during India’s Five Year Plans, mapped across plan periods. The dataset is used for monitoring service capacity trends and planning health infrastructure at subnational level. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} provides a State-wise assessment of required versus available health infrastructure, identifying shortfalls against prescribed norms. It supports planning and monitoring of infrastructure gaps. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} lists facilities available at sub-centres across Indian States/UTs. It supports planning, monitoring, and comparisons of sub-centre service readiness under the Family Welfare or health service delivery framework of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Values are provided with specified percentage calculations and cross-State/UT comparability.

{title} compiles State/UT-level counts of obstetricians and gynaecologists deployed at Community Health Centres (CHCs) located in tribal areas. It supports workforce planning, service availability assessments, and monitoring of maternal health specialist coverage under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

{title} compiles statistics on the average rural area and average radial distance covered by Primary Health Care Institutions across India. It supports planning and monitoring of primary health service coverage. Source is the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health and Family Welfare). Scope is by State/UT.

{title} provides a view of sanctioned and vacancy-related positions for female health workers and ANM postings at sub-centres across India. It supports manpower planning, monitoring of shortfalls, and compliance review by comparing state/UT-wise availability. Prepared under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare for Central use.

{title} compiles the total number of specialists available at Community Health Centres serving tribal areas, reported by State/UT. It supports planning, monitoring, and workforce assessment for family welfare and healthcare service delivery under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The data are provided at CHC level.
